text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I prepared a birthday present for you. 
They're athletic gloves. ...Do you want 
them?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want it! Aww, I'm so happy~ 
You actually had something prepared for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. I won't do it, but 
please don't throw it to hand it to me, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It might be an old custom, but "throwing 
down the gauntlet" means "I challenge you 
to a duel!" after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way, we don't do duels 
nowadays, so it just means something like 
"I'm cutting ties with you!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if anyone were to throw down the 
gauntlet, it would be me. In the 
traditional sense, of course.
